title: 第22章 噩梦第23章 藏宝图
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
至于成昆和胡天傲没说话，不过也是叹了口气。
“嗯，现在我先宣布第一件事，就是你们帮我寻找一些灵石，或者是一些千年药材之类的。如果你们帮我寻到了这些东西，我可以传授你们功夫，你们也看到了我有多强多厉害，你们哪怕学会了我1成本事也足以横行天下了，而且我也可以罩着你们。”
陈锋想了想说道。
对陈锋如今而言，他最需要的就是灵石和药材了，灵石可以用力吸收补充法力，也可以布阵；药材则是用来炼药了。
陈锋会炼药，会炼制培元丹，黄龙丹，筑基丹他也会，不过炼制这些丹药需要药材才能炼制，药材自然是年份越高越好，一般都需要千年以上的药材。
“好的好的高人，我们一定办到，我们一定竭尽全力为你寻找你需要的东西。”
成昆磕头如捣蒜，对于陈锋的命令他不敢不遵守，因为陈锋实在太强了，让他感觉到了恐惧。
“嗯，知道就好，对了不要叫我高人了，我才一米七我不高，我姓陈，叫我陈大师就是了。”
陈锋冷冷的道，然后身子一动就消失了无影无踪了。
过了良久，确定陈锋离开后，冯雪，胡天傲，成昆方才长长的松了口气，他们面面相觑，不知道该说什么好了。
“昆哥，难道我们就这么算了，真的要臣服他吗？”
冯雪有点不服气，毕竟冯雪身为五口堂第二分堂主，她心高气傲什么时候吃过这种亏，被打伤不说还要做对方的奴隶，还被迫吃下毒药。
“我们能怎么办，你也看到了那小子武功这么厉害，我猜测他起码也到了内劲大成了，甚至内劲巅峰也是有可能的，再说我们又吃了他的毒药，我们的性命都被他拿捏了，我可不想肠子烂掉。”
成昆摇头道。
“不过陈大师说如果我们真心为他做事就罩着我们，这个也未尝不是好事，毕竟他这么强，如果他真的罩我们我们五口堂自然会越来越强悍，说不定日后我们五口堂成为楚州甚至江北第一也说不定了。”
胡天傲想了想则说道，刚才他被陈凡打了一巴掌直接打断了三个肋骨，现在还疼的要死。
要知道他可是体修啊，别人就算用刀子砍都破不开他的防御的，但是陈锋那么强，陈锋还能徒手接机枪子弹。这让他实在是佩服的不行，也害怕的不行。
听到胡堂主的话，冯雪和成昆也点了点头，似乎是这样的，今日的事情说不定还是福气了，所以他们顿时又开心起来了。
……
另外一边，希尔顿酒店某处套房里，王杰正打算对林仙儿用强，他抱着林仙儿要亲热，可惜林仙儿死命不从。

“王少，你不要这样，我说过等我们结婚的那一天才可以。”
林仙儿一边推开了王杰的身体，她躲到了墙角里，防止王杰侵犯自己。
原来如今林仙儿虽然是王杰未婚妻，不过她一直都保护着自己，没有和王杰发生关系，林仙儿称乎只有到了双方结婚的那一天才行，这是她的底线。
“啪！”
王杰冲了过来，他气急败坏的给了林仙儿一个耳光，打的仙儿直接倒在了地上，那性感的嘴边更是冒出了红色的鲜血。
“你个贱婢，你以前和那个姓陈的在初中就谈过了，你们那时候没上过床吗？在老子面前装什么清纯。”
王杰气的骂道，原来在得知仙儿在以前和陈锋谈过恋爱后他越想越气，他怀疑仙儿已经不是c了，因为谈恋爱哪有不上床的。
他本来要验证一下，可惜仙儿不给他，他就着急了。
“我……我没。”
林仙儿从地上坐了起来，她不知道怎么解释，只能哭泣。
“等到新婚之夜老子看看，万一你不是c，老子弄死你。”
王杰恶狠狠的骂道，甩门而去。
……
另外一边，陈家。
此刻已经夜深了半夜两点，繁星点点，一轮弯月挂在空中。
content_en:
As for Cheng Kun and Hu Tianao, they didn't speak, but they just sighed.
"Well, the first thing I want to announce now is that you can help me find some spiritual stones, or some thousand-year-old medicinal materials. If you help me find these things, I can teach you kung fu. You have also seen how strong and powerful I am. Even if you learn one of my skills, you will be able to run rampant in the world, and I can also protect you."
Chen Feng thought for a while and said.
For Chen Feng now, what he needs most is spiritual stones and medicinal materials. Spiritual stones can be used to absorb and replenish mana, and can also be used to form formations; medicinal materials are used to refine medicine.
Chen Feng can refine medicine, and he can also refine Peiyuan Pill, Huanglong Pill, and Foundation Establishment Pill. However, refining these pills requires medicinal materials. Naturally, the older the medicinal materials are, the better. Generally, medicinal materials that are more than a thousand years old are needed.
"Okay, great master, we will definitely do it. We will do our best to find you what you need."
Cheng Kun kowtows like a fool. He dare not disobey Chen Feng's orders because Chen Feng is too strong and makes him feel afraid.
"Well, it's good to know. By the way, don't call me a master. I'm only 1.7 meters tall and I'm not tall. My surname is Chen. Just call me Master Chen."
Chen Feng said coldly, and then disappeared without a trace.
After a long time, after confirming that Chen Feng had left, Feng Xue, Hu Tianao, and Cheng Kun breathed a long sigh of relief. They looked at each other, not knowing what to say.
"Brother Kun, do we just forget it and really want to surrender to him?"
Feng Xue was a little dissatisfied. After all, Feng Xue was the second branch leader of the Five-Kou Hall. She was proud and arrogant. She had never suffered such a disadvantage. Not only was she injured, she had to be the slave of the other party, and she was also forced to take poison.
"What can we do? You have also seen how powerful that kid's martial arts is. I guess he has at least reached the peak of his internal energy. It is possible that he may even be at the peak of his internal energy. Besides, we have eaten his poison again, and our lives have been taken care of by him. I don't want our intestines to rot."
Cheng Kun shook his head.
"But Master Chen said that if we sincerely work for him, he will protect us. This is not a bad thing. After all, he is so strong. If he really protects us, our Wukoutang will naturally become stronger and stronger. Maybe in the future our Wukoutang will become the number one in Chuzhou or even Jiangbei."
Hu Tianao thought for a while and said, he was slapped by Chen Fan just now and three of his ribs were broken, and now he is still in pain.
You must know that he is a physical practitioner. Even if someone cuts him with a knife, he can't break through his defense. But Chen Feng is so strong, Chen Feng can still catch machine gun bullets with his bare hands. This made him really admired and scared.
After hearing Hall Master Hu's words, Feng Xue and Cheng Kun also nodded. It seemed like this, what happened today might be a blessing, so they suddenly became happy again.

On the other side, in a suite at the Hilton Hotel, Wang Jie was planning to use force on Lin Xianer. He hugged Lin Xianer and wanted to be intimate with her, but unfortunately Lin Xianer refused to comply.
"Young Master Wang, don't do this. I told you to wait until the day we get married."
Lin Xian'er pushed away Wang Jie's body and hid in the corner to prevent Wang Jie from violating her.
It turns out that although Lin Xian'er is Wang Jie's fiancée, she has always protected herself and has not had a relationship with Wang Jie. Lin Xian'er said that she can only do it on the day when the two parties get married. This is her bottom line.
"Crack!"
Wang Jie rushed over and angrily slapped Lin Xian'er in the face. The slap made Xian'er fall to the ground, and red blood came out of her sexy mouth.
"You bitch, you had a relationship with that guy surnamed Chen in junior high school. Didn't you guys have sex at that time? Why are you pretending to be innocent in front of me?"
Wang Jie cursed angrily. It turned out that after learning that Xianer had been in love with Chen Feng before, he became more and more angry.He suspected that Xian'er was no longer c, because there was no way to fall in love without having sex.
He originally wanted to verify it, but unfortunately Xian'er didn't give it to him, so he became anxious.
"I...I didn't."
Lin Xian'er sat up from the ground. She didn't know how to explain it, so she could only cry.
"I'll have a look on your wedding night. If you're not c, I'll kill you."
Wang Jie cursed fiercely, slammed the door and left.
…
On the other side, the Chen family.
It was already two o'clock in the middle of the night, the stars were shining brightly, and a crescent moon hung in the sky.
